evidence.what: the registry's tree_apps named pwa/nuxel-apps/privacy, which does not exist on disk -> the verifier returned FAILED (a real release blocker)
evidence.result: tree_apps states are now explicit (complete/in_progress/shared-assets-not-an-app require the dir; planned must not exist yet and is a printed DEFER); privacy is declared `planned` with its owner and ledger briq

evidence.what: POST /api/v1/apps/activate + GET /api/v1/apps/recent in services/nuxel-bridge/src/api.py: the launcher-to-app bridge resolves an app id to a descriptor built ONLY from the canonical registry (no client binary/command/url), refuses path-shaped ids before lookup, reports an unavailable registry as 503, and reports a declared-but-unlanded app tree as not launchable
evidence.result: a PWA cannot turn activation into arbitrary execution (asserted: no subprocess/os.system/exec/eval on the handler path)

evidence.what: services/nuxel-web/bin/nuxel-web-server.py replaces `python3 -m http.server` (installed to /usr/lib/nuxel/): explicit MIME (manifest+json, .mjs, .wasm), ETag+Last-Modified+304, Service-Worker-Allowed for sw scripts, per-class Cache-Control incl. immutable for ?v= assets, NUXEL_WEB_NO_CACHE for troubleshooting, threaded serving, no directory listings, traversal-proof
evidence.result: the stale-service-worker and serialised-request defects are closed; the shim keeps a documented fallback to the old server with a warning

evidence.what: pwa/nuxel-common/bridge.js grew activateApp()/recentActivations() and _request() now attaches the refusal reason (err.code) instead of losing it in 'bridge HTTP 404'
evidence.result: the client half of the activation contract is testable and honest

evidence.what: required_apps_not_yet_in_tree: the mission apps with no tree dir (permissions & privacy, firewall, VPN/Tor/remote, security auditor, system monitor) are recorded concept-level with owner + ledger briq, cross-checked against docs/beta-finalization/workqueue/
evidence.result: a mission requirement cannot point at work nobody owns; no directory path is guessed

tests: services/nuxel-bridge/test-launcher-activation.py: PASS (every app id resolved; refusal cases; no-execution assertions; bounded history; launcher wiring)
tools/s10plus/a33/tests/test-web-server.py: PASS (docroot verification + MIME + SW headers + cache policy + 304 + traversal + journal policy)
node pwa/nuxel-common/test-bridge.js: PASS (client pin, refusal codes, activation + history)
